title: himantoglossum caprinum var. calcaratum

The health benefits of Ruprecht's orchid include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect the body against free radicals and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-cancer properties.
